mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and increased discount rates, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a decline in demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of a broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 70% of the instances where HOUST decreases by more than 10% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in 3 months signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 5% YoY signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increases by more than 5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in 3 months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 2% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% in one month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases & UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% in 6 months signals a contraction in economic activity, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by a rise in unemployment (UNRATE).
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where GDPC1 decreases by more than 1% in 6 months, especially if UNRATE also increases.
